title: iOS exporter silently emits empty TARGETED_DEVICE_FAMILY for out-of-range targeted_device_family, app runs as iPhone-compatibility window on iPad
body:
### Tested versions

4.7.1.stable

### System information

macOS 15 (Apple Silicon), Xcode 26 (SDK iphoneos26.5), deploying to iPad Air (M3), iPadOS 26.5

### Issue description

`_process_config_file_line` in `platform/ios/export/export_plugin.cpp` switches on `application/targeted_device_family` handling only cases 0/1/2, with no default branch. A preset carrying an out-of-range value — e.g. `3`, which was the Godot **3.x bitmask** for iPhone|iPad and is a plausible migration leftover — silently generates `TARGETED_DEVICE_FAMILY = "";` in the exported Xcode project, producing an app whose built Info.plist has **no `UIDeviceFamily` key at all**.

**Consequence on iPadOS 26:** with no `UIDeviceFamily`, the app is classified as a legacy iPhone app and launches in a small, non-resizable iPhone-compatibility window — dead maximize button, and `UIScreen.main.bounds` reporting 320×480 from inside the app. Nothing about the failure points back to the preset value; we lost several days to it (off and on), chasing windowing plist keys that were irrelevant.

We confirmed causality with a control experiment: three minimal, individually signed non-Godot apps differing only in this key — the app without `UIDeviceFamily` reproduces the compatibility window exactly; the identical app with `UIDeviceFamily [1,2]` launches full screen.

### Steps to reproduce

1. In any iOS export preset, set `application/targeted_device_family=3` in `export_presets.cfg` (or migrate a Godot 3.x project that had the bitmask value).
2. Export for iOS; inspect the generated `project.pbxproj` → `TARGETED_DEVICE_FAMILY = "";` in all configurations.
3. Inspect the built ipa's Info.plist → `UIDeviceFamily` is absent.
4. Install on an iPad running iPadOS 26 → app launches in a small scaled compatibility window.

### Suggested fix

Validate the enum at export time (error, or clamp with a warning), and/or give the switch a default of `"1,2"` instead of falling through to an empty string. A brief migration note for 3.x presets (bitmask → enum) would also help.

### Minimal reproduction project

Trivially reproducible with any empty project by editing `export_presets.cfg` as above (step 1); the defect is in preset handling, not project content.
